module: Flowgraph node "Audio Fade In" (category once_f_duration, tags sound/audio/volume). Brings the global volume back up: sets the FMOD global parameters g_FadeTimeMS (= duration in ms) and g_GameLoading = 0 via SFXSystem.setGlobalParameter, then waits for the duration to signal completion. Input: duration (s, default 1). The output flow goes to the "finished" state when the time has elapsed.
notes: This is the mirror version of Audio Fade Out (which sets g_GameLoading to 1). The actual fade is done by the audio system through these parameters; the node only counts the time.

_executionStopped.desc: Calls reset() when the graph stops.

onNodeReset.desc: Calls reset() when the node is reset.

reset.desc: Sets the timer back to 0, the duration state to 'inactive' and the parameters g_FadeTimeMS and g_GameLoading to 0.

workOnce.desc: On the first flow: g_FadeTimeMS = duration*1000, g_GameLoading = 0, duration state 'started'.

work.desc: Every frame: advances the timer (mgr.dtReal) and sets the state to 'finished' once duration is reached.
